posts.title: 22 sessions of Blades in the Dark
posts.description: I ran Blades in the Dark for 10 sessions over three months at Role Play Haven . I'd also played it for about 12 sessions before that. Here are my impressions. Deep Cuts I decided to run Blades with all the additional systems from the Deep Cuts extension. I also used the premise of fissures appearing in the world as a major storyline. posts.title: Handmade table raiser for TTRPGs
posts.description: I have a medium sized kitchen table which also doubles as gaming table. When I was running a year-long campaign of Dungeons & Dragons, I struggled to find space on that table for maps. We always serve food at our games and for six people plus a GM screen there wasn’t much space left for maps covering 4x A4 sheets.
